label: ClickUp
description: Task and project management across ClickUp workspaces, spaces, and lists.
notes: clickup.createTask SKIPPED: live catalog already has an equal-or-better node (template-safe transpile of AP create_task cannot add priority/assignees/due_date/custom_fields because they require typed JSON values). getTask drops the optional include_subtasks boolean query param (blank value not tolerated). updateTask keeps only name (required) and description; status/priority/assignees dropped — status rejects empty string, priority is a JSON number, assignees is {add,rem} number arrays. Per ClickUp docs an empty-string description on update is ignored (clearing requires a single space), so the optional key is safe. createTaskComment hardcodes notify_all:true (JSON literal, matching AP behavior) and drops the optional assignee (JSON number; AP falls back to a second /user request we cannot express). listTeamTasks keeps only workspaceId + page (required, default 0); assignees/tags/space_ids/list_ids/order_by/reverse/include_closed dropped because blank query values are not tolerated and arrays cannot be encoded. Auth is AP OAuth2 -> CLICKUP_API_TOKEN with Bearer prefix; the pre-existing catalog createTask node uses a personal CLICKUP_API_TOKEN without Bearer — both are valid ClickUp auth styles.
